sentences.zh: 我曾在凌晨4点半给总统打电话，他接听了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享受优惠，请访问 nytimes.com/subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的瑞秋·艾布拉姆斯，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: An explosive whistleblower report claims that the Justice Department is asking government lawyers to lie to the courts.
sentences.zh: 一份爆炸性的举报人报告称，司法部正在要求政府律师向法院撒谎。

sentences.en: and that that has forced career officials to choose between upholding the Constitution or pledging loyalty to the president.
sentences.zh: 这迫使职业官员必须在维护宪法和向总统效忠之间做出选择。

sentences.en: Today, I speak to that whistleblower.
sentences.zh: 今天，我将采访那位举报人。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, July 23rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月23日，星期三。

sentences.en: Eris Ruvaini, welcome to The Daily.
sentences.zh: 埃里斯·鲁瓦尼，欢迎来到《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: I spoke to Eris Ruvaini, the whistleblower, on Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一，我采访了举报人埃里斯·鲁瓦尼。

sentences.en: I'm very curious how you feel being with us today.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇你今天和我们在一起是什么感觉。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, I didn't have this on my life bingo card, but I'm happy to be here and happy to tell my story and happy that you all want to hear it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是说，我的人生清单里可没想过会发生这种事，但我很高兴能来到这里，讲述我的故事，也很高兴你们都愿意倾听。

sentences.en: In 2010, Ruvani joined the Justice Department's
sentences.zh: 2010年，鲁瓦尼加入了司法部的

sentences.en: Office of Immigration Litigation, where he worked until he was fired in April of this year.
sentences.zh: 移民诉讼办公室，他在那里工作直到今年4月被解雇。

sentences.en: And then in June, he filed a whistleblower complaint that alleges he was, quote, thwarted, threatened, fired, and publicly disparaged
sentences.zh: 然后在6月，他提交了一份举报投诉，声称他被“阻挠、威胁、解雇并公开诋毁”，

sentences.en: for both doing his job and telling the truths of the court because his clients engaged in unlawful activity, abused their authority,
sentences.zh: 原因是他履行职责并向法院陈述事实，因为他的客户从事非法活动、滥用职权、

sentences.en: created substantial and specific threat to health and safety, and because the pattern of this conduct continues to this day.
sentences.zh: 对健康和安全构成了重大且具体的威胁，而且这种行为模式一直持续至今。

sentences.en: Look, I've been a DOJ attorney for 15 years, and the things that I experienced in that three-week window from March 14th to April 5th when I was suspended
sentences.zh: 听着，我担任司法部律师已经15年了，我在3月14日到4月5日被停职的那三周里所经历的事情

sentences.en: are unprecedented.
sentences.zh: 是前所未有的。

sentences.en: I've never seen anything like it.
sentences.zh: 我从未见过这样的事。

sentences.en: His whistleblower complaint focuses on directives he got from senior political appointees at the Justice Department,
sentences.zh: 他的举报投诉重点在于他从司法部高级政治任命官员那里收到的指令，

sentences.en: including from Emile Bovee, who, before joining the DOJ, was President Trump's personal lawyer.
sentences.zh: 其中包括埃米尔·博维，他在加入司法部之前曾是特朗普总统的私人律师。

sentences.en: So I've come forward because the Trump administration has put civil servants in this impossible position of fealty to the president and the agenda,
sentences.zh: 所以我站了出来，因为特朗普政府将公务员置于一个不可能的境地：要么效忠总统和其议程，

sentences.en: or fealty to uphold the Constitution and to uphold the rule of law.
sentences.zh: 要么效忠于维护宪法和法治。

sentences.en: And time and time again during those three weeks, I was put to the question, which side am I going to be on?
sentences.zh: 在那三周里，我一次又一次地被质问：我到底站在哪一边？

sentences.en: And ultimately, I mean, I didn't sign up until Idaho court.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，我是说，我没签过那种卖身契。

sentences.en: And that's the position I was put in, and that's the position others are being put in, and that's why I've come forward.
sentences.zh: 这就是我所处的境地，也是其他人所处的境地，这就是我站出来的原因。

sentences.en: It also sounds like, if I'm kind of hearing you correctly and reading between the lines a little bit, that, like, you have an image of what the DOJ is supposed to be.
sentences.zh: 听起来，如果我没理解错，并且从字里行间读出一点意思的话，你对司法部应该是什么样子有一个设想。

sentences.en: And maybe to start, can you just talk about why and how you end up at the Justice Department to begin with?
sentences.zh: 也许我们可以先谈谈，你当初为什么以及如何进入司法部工作的？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: I mean, I was at a law firm in San Francisco for a couple years after clerking for two federal judges.
sentences.zh: 我在为两位联邦法官担任书记员后，在旧金山的一家律师事务所工作了几年。

sentences.en: And that was never the end game.
sentences.zh: 那从来都不是我的终极目标。

sentences.en: I went there just because the money paid well.
sentences.zh: 我去那里只是因为薪水高。

sentences.en: I wanted to live in San Francisco for a brief period of time, but I always wanted to get into public service.
sentences.zh: 我想在旧金山住上一段时间，但我一直想投身公共服务。

sentences.en: And the key marquee place to do that everyone understood at the time, and I still until recently felt this way, was the Department of Justice.
sentences.zh: 当时每个人都知道，而且直到最近我也一直这么认为，公共服务的金字招牌就是司法部。

sentences.en: Because right away, you are leading big cases.
sentences.zh: 因为你一进去就能负责重大案件。

sentences.en: You're standing up in court.
sentences.zh: 你站在法庭上。

sentences.en: You're saying heirs ruveni on behalf of the United States.
sentences.zh: 你说：“埃里斯·鲁瓦尼，代表美国政府。”

sentences.en: You're not necessarily saying heirs ruveni on behalf of some large faceless corporation.
sentences.zh: 你不是在说：“埃里斯·鲁瓦尼，代表某家大型无名企业。”

sentences.en: You're here really representing the people of the United States.
sentences.zh: 你在这里真正代表的是美国人民。

sentences.en: And the thing that I've always thought about when trying to explain this is there's this Supreme Court case from 1935 in which the Supreme Court tells you what it is to be a government lawyer.
sentences.zh: 在试图解释这一点时，我总是想到1935年的一个最高法院案件，最高法院在案中阐述了政府律师的职责。

sentences.en: And the role of the government attorney, the Supreme Court writes, is not simply to win.
sentences.zh: 最高法院写道，政府律师的角色不仅仅是为了胜诉。

sentences.en: It's to make sure justice is done.
sentences.zh: 而是要确保正义得到伸张。

sentences.en: And that's that's the thrill of standing up in court and saying your name on behalf of the United States.
sentences.zh: 这就是站在法庭上代表美国政府发言的意义所在。

sentences.en: You sound, I just want to point out, idealistic.
sentences.zh: 我想指出的是，你听起来很有理想主义色彩。

sentences.en: It sounds like that's why you went to the DOJ.
sentences.zh: 听起来这就是你去司法部的原因。

sentences.en: I think that'd be fair to say.
sentences.zh: 我想这样说很公平。

sentences.en: So when you first joined the Justice Department, did it feel like what you thought being a DOJ attorney would feel like?
sentences.zh: 那么当你第一次加入司法部时，感觉和你预想的司法部律师工作一样吗？

sentences.en: Like, did it feel like the job was living up to the idealistic vision that you had or your ethical expectations?
sentences.zh: 这份工作是否符合你理想中的愿景或道德期望？

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对符合。

sentences.en: And I think it's not true specific or uniquely to the Obama administration.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这不仅适用于奥巴马政府。

sentences.en: It's true even the first Trump administration, the Biden administration.
sentences.zh: 即使在第一届特朗普政府和拜登政府时期也是如此。

sentences.en: When you got a court order, you followed it.
sentences.zh: 当你收到法院命令时，你就会遵守它。

sentences.en: So let's fast forward to the first Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 那么让我们快进到第一届特朗普政府时期。

sentences.en: Can you tell us about some of the immigration cases you worked on during the first administration?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们你在第一届政府期间处理过的一些移民案件吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: I think the most high-profile one would have been the first one, the travel ban that sort of issued January 27th, 2017.
sentences.zh: 我想最引人注目的应该是第一个，即2017年1月27日发布的旅行禁令。

sentences.en: That occupied the first few months, frankly, of the Trump administration in the immigration space.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，那占据了特朗普政府在移民领域最初的几个月。

sentences.en: And I can recall working 100-hour weeks defending it in January and February of that year.
sentences.zh: 我记得在那一年的1月和2月，我每周工作100个小时来为它辩护。

sentences.en: This was the travel ban that was colloquially known as the Muslim ban?
sentences.zh: 这就是俗称的“穆斯林禁令”吗？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: How did it feel to defend that?
sentences.zh: 为它辩护是什么感觉？

sentences.en: Because obviously that was an extremely controversial case.
sentences.zh: 因为显然那是一个极具争议的案件。

sentences.en: Did you have any concerns representing the government on that issue?
sentences.zh: 你在代表政府处理该问题时有什么顾虑吗？

sentences.en: So at that time, no.
sentences.zh: 当时没有。

sentences.en: At that time, I did not have concerns because if we got a court order, as I did, which said you may not apply the travel ban in the state of Virginia, we complied with it.
sentences.zh: 当时我没有顾虑，因为如果我们收到了法院命令，就像我当时那样，说你不得在弗吉尼亚州实施旅行禁令，我们就遵守了它。

sentences.en: And if we didn't like it, we appealed.
sentences.zh: 如果我们不喜欢，我们就上诉。

sentences.en: You were comfortable doing whatever was within the limits of your abilities and the limits of the law.
sentences.zh: 你很乐意在你的能力范围内和法律范围内做任何事情。

sentences.en: I mean, that's part of being a government lawyer.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这是政府律师职责的一部分。

sentences.en: You may not like everything you defend, but you're still there working with the client to do something within the confines of the law.
sentences.zh: 你可能不喜欢你辩护的所有事情，但你仍然在那里与客户合作，在法律范围内行事。

sentences.en: And the client here would have been the Department of Homeland Security and State.
sentences.zh: 这里的客户是国土安全部和国务院。

sentences.en: Just to put a really fine point on it, we know from some of our colleagues reporting that in the first term,
sentences.zh: 为了把话说得更清楚一点，我们从同事的报道中得知，在第一任期内，

sentences.en: the administration was frustrated with attorneys who they saw as standing in their way, particularly on issues of immigration.
sentences.zh: 政府对那些他们认为阻碍其工作的律师感到不满，特别是在移民问题上。

sentences.en: It does not sound like that you were that type of lawyer.
sentences.zh: 听起来你并不是那种律师。

sentences.en: You are not somebody who is pushing back against the Trump administration because you may have political or personal opposition to the policies.
sentences.zh: 你不是那种因为政治或个人反对政策而抵制特朗普政府的人。

sentences.en: You were doing your job.
sentences.zh: 你只是在做你的工作。

sentences.en: You worked within the confines of what was legal, and that is what matters.
sentences.zh: 你在法律允许的范围内工作，这才是最重要的。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: I mean, the Trump administration promoted me and gave me three awards, if I recall correctly, during the first Trump administration for work I've done defending the very policies
sentences.zh: 我是说，如果我没记错的话，特朗普政府在第一届任期内还提拔了我，并给了我三个奖项，以表彰我为辩护我们刚才提到的那些政策所做的工作，

sentences.en: we're just talking about now, including the travel ban.
sentences.zh: 包括旅行禁令。

sentences.en: So I'm there to do my job as a government attorney.
sentences.zh: 所以我去那里是为了履行我作为政府律师的职责。

sentences.en: I may not personally agree or disagree with everything I'm defending, regardless of who's the president,
sentences.zh: 无论谁是总统，我个人可能并不完全同意我所辩护的一切，

sentences.en: but the job is to defend vigorously the administration's goals within the confines of the law.
sentences.zh: 但工作职责就是在法律范围内有力地捍卫政府的目标。

sentences.en: Coming up to the 2024 election, the Trump campaign made it very clear that a second Trump administration was going to be much more aggressive about immigration.
sentences.zh: 临近2024年大选时，特朗普竞选团队明确表示，第二届特朗普政府在移民问题上会更加激进。

sentences.en: And I wonder how you interpreted that.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是如何解读这一点的。

sentences.en: Like, what did you think and what were you expecting?
sentences.zh: 你当时是怎么想的，你预料到了什么？

sentences.en: Having led litigation during the first Trump administration and seen sort of how that unfolded, I think we, and this may be my personal thought,
sentences.zh: 在第一届特朗普政府期间领导过诉讼并目睹了事情的发展，我想我们——这可能是我个人的想法，

sentences.en: I don't want to put this view in anyone else's head, but we thought it'd be less chaotic.
sentences.zh: 我不想把这种观点强加给任何人——但我们认为情况会没那么混乱。

sentences.en: Like, they've done this already.
sentences.zh: 就像，他们已经做过一次了。

sentences.en: They sort of maybe have a better handle on how to put out policy that survives the courts.
sentences.zh: 他们可能更清楚如何制定能在法院存续的政策。

sentences.en: We thought they would be more orderly compared to the first Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 我们认为与第一届特朗普政府相比，他们会更有条理。

sentences.en: So when President Trump's second term actually begins, you do start to grow more concerned about how the administration is enacting on this immigration agenda.
sentences.zh: 所以当特朗普总统的第二个任期真正开始时，你确实开始对政府如何实施这一移民议程感到更加担忧。

sentences.en: So take me to the first moment when you started to feel that concern.
sentences.zh: 那么带我回到你开始感到担忧的第一个时刻。

sentences.en: What exactly happened and why did it bother you?
sentences.zh: 到底发生了什么，为什么让你感到困扰？

sentences.en: Yeah, this, I think, is March 14th of this year.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想那是今年的3月14日。

sentences.en: And this is the same day where I am informed that I will soon be promoted to the acting deputy director for the Office of Immigration Litigation,
sentences.zh: 就在同一天，我被告知我很快将被提拔为移民诉讼办公室的代理副主任，

sentences.en: which means I would essentially be the person overseeing all the district court litigation.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我基本上将成为监督所有地方法院诉讼的人。

sentences.en: Basically, the buck stops with me on quality control for anything going through the district courts.
sentences.zh: 基本上，地方法院处理的任何案件的质量控制责任都在我身上。

sentences.en: So that same day that I'm told that I am going to serve in this role, I am summoned with very little context to a meeting in the deputy attorney general's conference room, along
sentences.zh: 所以就在我被告知将担任这一职务的同一天，我被传唤到副总检察长的会议室开会，几乎没有任何背景说明，

sentences.en: with Drew Ensign, the political in charge of immigration litigation, and my supervisor, who at the time was the acting director.
sentences.zh: 与负责移民诉讼的政治官员德鲁·恩赛恩，以及我当时的直属上司——代理主任一起。

sentences.en: So at this meeting, we are told by Emile Bovey, who is running the meeting, the president
sentences.zh: 在这次会议上，主持会议的埃米尔·博维告诉我们，总统

sentences.en: was going to sign a proclamation invoking a rarely used 1798 wartime law, the Alien Enemies
sentences.zh: 将签署一项公告，援引一项很少使用的1798年战时法律——《外籍敌侨法》，

sentences.en: Act, and that planes containing individuals subject to this proclamation, Venezuelan nationals alleged to be members of the Tren Daragua gang, were going to take off that weekend.
sentences.zh: 并且载有受此公告约束的个人（据称是委内瑞拉“阿拉瓜火车”帮派成员的委内瑞拉国民）的飞机将在那个周末起飞。

sentences.en: This was a surprise.
sentences.zh: 这很突然。

sentences.en: I mean, we had heard Stephen Miller and folks he was associated with in 2024 talk about the Alien Enemies Act.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们在2024年听过斯蒂芬·米勒和他相关的人谈论《外籍敌侨法》。

sentences.en: And so we were vaguely aware that this might be something at some point they would implement.
sentences.zh: 所以我们模糊地意识到这可能是他们未来某个时候会实施的东西。

sentences.en: But the key thing here, this is the important part of why this is so unusual, is this is a wartime law.
sentences.zh: 但关键在于——这是为什么这如此不同寻常的重要部分——这是一项战时法律。

sentences.en: It's only been invoked three times in the nation's history.
sentences.zh: 它在国家历史上只被援引过三次。

sentences.en: It's never been invoked when there isn't a state of war.
sentences.zh: 它从未在没有战争状态的情况下被援引过。

sentences.en: And in the normal course, even in the first Trump administration, the way one implements a somewhat aggressive reading of
sentences.zh: 在正常情况下，即使在第一届特朗普政府期间，实施某种激进的法律解读的方式也是

sentences.en: the law is you sit down with the lawyers, you come up with the best way to roll this out in the courts.
sentences.zh: 你坐下来与律师商讨，想出在法庭上推行此事的最佳方式。

sentences.en: You don't make the rollout operationally chaotic.
sentences.zh: 你不会让推行过程在操作上变得混乱。

sentences.en: None of that happened here.
sentences.zh: 这里什么都没发生。

sentences.en: And so we have no context at this meeting for what we're about to hear, what the plan is, how it's going to be implemented.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在这次会议上对即将听到的内容、计划是什么、如何实施一无所知。

sentences.en: And no one asks our opinion either.
sentences.zh: 也没有人征求我们的意见。

sentences.en: Nobody seems to care our thoughts on how to defend this or if it's defensible.
sentences.zh: 似乎没人关心我们对于如何辩护或它是否可辩护的想法。

sentences.en: What happens after that?
sentences.zh: 那之后发生了什么？

sentences.en: Tell us what they instruct you to do.
sentences.zh: 告诉我们他们指示你做什么。

sentences.en: So Bovey, who again is leading the meeting, tells everyone in attendance that this invocation of
sentences.zh: 所以再次主持会议的博维告诉所有与会者，这次援引

sentences.en: the Alien Enemies Act to remove certain Venezuelan nationals is of the highest importance to the
sentences.zh: 《外籍敌侨法》以驱逐某些委内瑞拉国民对白宫来说至关重要。

sentences.en: White House.
sentences.zh: 停顿片刻后，他再次向房间里的每个人强调，那些飞机必须起飞，“无论如何”。

sentences.en: And after a pause, emphasizing to everyone again in the room, those planes have to take off, quote, no matter what.
sentences.zh: 然后又停顿了一下。

sentences.en: And then there's another pause there.
sentences.zh: 然后，这就是为接下来三周定下基调的事情。

sentences.en: And then this is the thing that sets the tone for the next three weeks.
sentences.zh: 博维说，如果法院发布了阻止这种情况发生的命令，我们必须考虑告诉法院：“去你的”。

sentences.en: Bovee says, and if some court were to issue some order that prevents that from happening, we would have to consider telling that court, quote, fuck you.
sentences.zh: 当他说那句话时，你在想什么？

sentences.en: What were you thinking in that moment when he said that?
sentences.zh: 我觉得就像一颗手榴弹爆炸了。

sentences.en: I felt like a grenade had gone off.
sentences.zh: 他在开玩笑吗？

sentences.en: Like, is he serious?
sentences.zh: 我不清楚他是在演戏，还是在虚张声势、拍胸脯。

sentences.en: It wasn't clear to me if it was just acting or bravado, chest-thumping.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Like, it was crazy.
sentences.zh: 在长时间的沉默后，

sentences.en: And after a very long pause,
sentences.zh: 我的直属上司说：“好吧，如果我们收到命令，我们会建议我们的客户遵守命令。”

sentences.en: my immediate supervisor says, well, if we get an order, we would advise our clients to follow the order.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我们很快就离开了会议室。

sentences.en: And after that, we rushed it out of the conference room very quickly.
sentences.zh: 会议在那之后不久就结束了。

sentences.en: The meeting ended shortly after that.
sentences.zh: 为了非常清楚地说明为什么这让你如此震惊，律师通常不会对法院说“去你的”，对吧？

sentences.en: Just to lay out super clearly why this took you aback so much is that lawyers do not regularly say F you to the courts, right?
sentences.zh: 遵守法院命令是最大、最明显的红线。

sentences.en: Like, abiding by a court order is the biggest, brightest red line.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们经常收到对白宫目标不利的法院命令。

sentences.en: Yeah, we get court orders that are bad for the goals of whoever is in the White House all the time.
sentences.zh: 但你通常的做法是遵守命令，除非且直到你在上诉中推翻它，或者被上级法院中止执行。

sentences.en: But the normal thing you do is you follow the order unless and until you get it reversed on appeal or stayed by a higher court.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们经常收到对白宫目标不利的法院命令，但通常的做法是遵守命令，除非且直到你在上诉中推翻它，或者被上级法院中止执行。

sentences.en: You don't just preemptively announce, yeah, we're just not going to follow that one.
sentences.zh: 你不能仅仅因为预先宣布了，就说，是的，我们就是不打算遵守那一条。

sentences.en: That was highly unusual.
sentences.zh: 那是非常罕见的。

sentences.en: I'd never heard anything like it in my 15 years.
sentences.zh: 在我这15年的职业生涯中，我从未听说过这样的事。

sentences.en: Did you think walking out of that meeting, that was probably just bluster, we're not actually going to be asked to do that?
sentences.zh: 你走出那场会议时，有没有想过，那可能只是虚张声势，我们实际上不会被要求那样做？

sentences.en: Once my supervisor spoke up to say, well, no, we would advise our clients to follow court orders, yeah, I felt a little bit better about it.
sentences.zh: 一旦我的主管站出来说，嗯，不，我们会建议我们的客户遵守法院命令，是的，我对此感觉好了一些。

sentences.en: I felt that, okay, this is not something we need to worry about.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，好吧，这不是我们需要担心的事情。

sentences.en: What happened after that?
sentences.zh: 那之后发生了什么？

sentences.en: So the attorneys from the ACLU file a lawsuit that I become aware of at 7.30 the next day.
sentences.zh: 所以美国公民自由联盟（ACLU）的律师提起了一项诉讼，我在第二天早上7点半才得知此事。

sentences.en: So by that morning, Judge Boesberg had issued a TRO.
sentences.zh: 所以到那天早上，博斯伯格法官已经发布了临时限制令（TRO）。

sentences.en: The judge in this case.
sentences.zh: 本案的法官。

sentences.en: Yes, which is a temporary restraining order.
sentences.zh: 是的，也就是临时限制令。

sentences.en: And so as was telegraphed at the meeting the day before, we know that we're going to be spending our weekend defending this Alien Enemies Act operation,
sentences.zh: 正如前一天会议上所暗示的那样，我们知道我们将不得不花周末的时间来为这项《外籍敌侨法》行动进行辩护，

sentences.en: and we're going to be in court on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 而且我们周六还要出庭。

sentences.en: And there was a hearing set for 4 p.m.
sentences.zh: 当时定于下午4点举行听证会。

sentences.en: later that day.
sentences.zh: 就在那天晚些时候。

sentences.en: That hearing got moved to 5, and then we appeared at that hearing.
sentences.zh: 那场听证会被推迟到了5点，然后我们出席了听证会。

sentences.en: And by we, I mean Drew Ensign.
sentences.zh: 我说的“我们”，指的是德鲁·恩赛恩（Drew Ensign）。

sentences.en: Drew Ensign handled the argument for the government.
sentences.zh: 德鲁·恩赛恩负责代表政府进行辩论。

sentences.en: And now, just to sidebar here for a second, And Ensign was at the same meeting I was at.
sentences.zh: 现在，先插一句，恩赛恩当时和我参加的是同一个会议。

sentences.en: And he heard the same things that I heard from Mr. Bovee, including that planes are taking off over the weekend and that they need to take off no matter what,
sentences.zh: 他听到了我和博维（Bovee）先生听到的一样的话，包括飞机在周末起飞，而且无论如何都必须起飞，

sentences.en: and this is the highest priority of the White House.
sentences.zh: 这是白宫的最高优先事项。

sentences.en: So Bosberg asks him, are there any planes taking off?
sentences.zh: 所以博斯伯格问他，有没有飞机起飞？

sentences.en: And he says, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 他说，我不知道。

sentences.en: I believe that to not be a plausible answer from someone in Mr. Ensign's position since he was at the same meeting as me.
sentences.zh: 我认为对于恩赛恩先生这样职位的人来说，这并不是一个可信的回答，因为他和我参加的是同一个会议。

sentences.en: You think he lied?
sentences.zh: 你认为他撒谎了？

sentences.en: I believe he lied.
sentences.zh: 我相信他撒谎了。

sentences.en: I don't see how he could have come away from that meeting with the impression that no planes were taking off over the next 24 to 48 hours.
sentences.zh: 我不明白他怎么可能在开完那个会后，还会认为未来24到48小时内没有飞机起飞。

sentences.en: And that's sort of the first operationalization, if you will, of the FU.
sentences.zh: 这算是“去你的”（FU）政策的第一次实际操作，如果你愿意这么称呼的话。

sentences.en: So here we have the political head of the immigration section
sentences.zh: 所以在这里，我们看到移民部门的政治负责人

sentences.en: telling the court, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 告诉法庭，我不知道。

sentences.en: What was your reaction when you heard your colleague, as you put it, lying to a judge.
sentences.zh: 当你听到你的同事，正如你所说的那样，对法官撒谎时，你的反应是什么？

sentences.en: Oh, shit.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: How can he say that?
sentences.zh: 他怎么能那样说？

sentences.en: That's just not true.
sentences.zh: 那根本不是事实。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So at this point, you've seen your colleagues do behavior that you find highly objectionable, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 所以此时此刻，你已经看到你的同事做出了你认为非常令人反感的行为，听起来是这样。

sentences.en: At what point do you actually get involved?
sentences.zh: 你是在什么时候真正介入的？

sentences.en: Well, I'm talking to my immediate supervisor in real time as this is happening the evening of March 15th, And I'm I'm banging the drum of.
sentences.zh: 嗯，3月15日晚上，当这一切发生时，我正在实时与我的直属主管交谈，我一直在强调：

sentences.en: This is not right.
sentences.zh: 这不对劲。

sentences.en: We're lying potentially to the court.
sentences.zh: 我们可能在对法庭撒谎。

sentences.en: And the following day,
sentences.zh: 第二天，

sentences.en: we get this email from the acting assistant attorney general who tells us that the decision has been made by Bovee to essentially I'm paraphrasing to ignore this order that Bozberg issued to not let those people off those planes.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了代理助理司法部长发来的邮件，他告诉我们博维已经做出了决定——我是在转述——要无视博斯伯格发布的不要让那些人下飞机的命令。

sentences.en: And that Bovee had said, no, that's not an order we need to follow.
sentences.zh: 而且博维说，不，那不是我们需要遵守的命令。

sentences.en: Let those people off the planes.
sentences.zh: 让那些人下飞机。

sentences.en: And then on Twitter, you can see, like, this video where they just hand these individuals over to the El Salvadorian authorities and transfer them to CICOT,
sentences.zh: 然后你在推特上可以看到一段视频，他们直接把这些人移交给萨尔瓦多当局，并把他们转移到CICOT，

sentences.en: the maximum security prison.
sentences.zh: 那是一所最高安全级别的监狱。

sentences.en: And that's when we really did tell the court FU really sunk in.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，我们真正意识到“去你的”这句话的含义了。

sentences.en: Because now these folks are in Salvadorian custody at a maximum security prison.
sentences.zh: 因为现在这些人已经处于萨尔瓦多当局的拘留之下，被关在最高安全级别的监狱里。

sentences.en: And so we are all just stunned that we have had any participation in what has just happened.
sentences.zh: 所以我们所有人都感到震惊，我们竟然参与了刚刚发生的一切。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是Wena Liu。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写了《Connections》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是Sam Mazursky，我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的这些人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问nytimes.com/games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: So what's the next thing that happens that concerns you just as far as telling the truth to the judge, obeying court orders, etc.?
sentences.zh: 那么，接下来发生的哪件事让你感到担忧，就对法官说实话、遵守法院命令等方面而言？

sentences.en: Yeah, so fast forward to March 28th, and there's a second case.
sentences.zh: 是的，快进到3月28日，出现了第二个案件。

sentences.en: A judge issues an order forbidding the government from removing individuals to third countries, countries that they're not from,
sentences.zh: 一位法官发布了一项命令，禁止政府在没有遵循某些最低限度程序的情况下，将个人移交给他们并非来自的第三国，

sentences.en: without following certain minimal process beforehand.
sentences.zh: 即在事先没有遵循某些最低限度程序的情况下。

sentences.en: And very quickly, a new facet of the FU makes an appearance here.
sentences.zh: 很快，“去你的”政策的又一个新层面在这里出现了。

sentences.en: So normally, one of the roles of DOJ, regardless of what the subject matter is, if we get an adverse court order,
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，司法部的职责之一，无论主题是什么，如果我们收到不利的法院命令，

sentences.en: we work with the agency to draft language informing the non-lawyers within the agency about what they are now allowed or not allowed to do vis-a-vis this policy.
sentences.zh: 我们会与该机构合作起草文件，告知机构内的非律师人员，根据这项政策，他们现在被允许或不被允许做什么。

sentences.en: So that everybody can follow the law.
sentences.zh: 这样每个人都能遵守法律。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's the idea.
sentences.zh: 这就是初衷。

sentences.en: Part of the job, because otherwise you take ICE officers, for example, if they remove somebody that the court has said it's illegal to do that.
sentences.zh: 这是工作的一部分，因为否则的话，以移民及海关执法局（ICE）的官员为例，如果他们移交了法院已裁定为非法的人员，

sentences.en: Now that's them on the line, potentially some sort of lawsuit with financial damages attached to it.
sentences.zh: 那他们自己就麻烦了，可能会面临某种附带经济赔偿的诉讼。

sentences.en: So it's our job as lawyers to protect these law enforcement officers when there's an order out there saying, don't do this thing because this will be illegal if you do it.
sentences.zh: 所以我们的律师职责是保护这些执法人员，当有命令说“不要做这件事，因为这样做是非法的”时。

sentences.en: And the key F you move here was we were forbidden from working with DHS to circulate guidance about this injunction.
sentences.zh: 而这里关键的“去你的”举动是，我们被禁止与国土安全部（DHS）合作发布关于这项禁令的指导意见。

sentences.en: just it was it this was just i'd never seen this before just we're not going to send out any guidance
sentences.zh: 这简直……我以前从未见过这种情况，就是“我们不打算发出任何指导意见”，

sentences.en: stop putting things in writing about this injunction and that weekend after this injunction
sentences.zh: 停止就这项禁令进行书面记录，而在那项禁令发布后的那个周末，

sentences.en: issued another flight took off depositing 17 more individuals in salvadoran custody at secot and you
sentences.zh: 又有一架飞机起飞，将另外17人送入萨尔瓦多拘留所，关进塞科特（Seacot）监狱，而你……

sentences.en: think just to be clear here you think that ice was deliberately kept in the dark so that those
sentences.zh: 你认为——为了明确起见——你认为ICE是被故意蒙在鼓里的，以便那些

sentences.en: flights could take off like so that they didn't know that they weren't supposed to do that 100
sentences.zh: 航班能够起飞？也就是说，他们不知道自己不应该那样做？100%。

sentences.en: And this also allows someone who's a decision maker to stick their head in the sand and say, la, la, la, I don't know what's happening here.
sentences.zh: 这也让决策者能够掩耳盗铃，说：“啦啦啦，我不知道这里发生了什么。”

sentences.en: And so I didn't violate an order.
sentences.zh: 所以我没有违反命令。

sentences.en: I didn't know about it.
sentences.zh: 我对此一无所知。

sentences.en: That's why I was told to stop putting questions in writing about the injunction, I believe.
sentences.zh: 我相信这就是为什么我被告知停止就禁令提出书面问题的原因。

sentences.en: Because if there's no paper trail, it makes that denial more plausible.
sentences.zh: 因为如果没有书面记录，这种否认就显得更可信了。

sentences.en: What is the next plot point in you feeling like you're unable to do your job because of some of the directions that you're getting from your bosses?
sentences.zh: 在你因为老板的一些指示而感到无法完成工作时，下一个情节是什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, this is when we get to the third case, the Abrego-Garcia case.
sentences.zh: 是的，这就是我们谈到的第三个案件，Abrego-Garcia案。

sentences.en: This is the Maryland father who was wrongfully deported to El Salvador.
sentences.zh: 这就是那位被错误地驱逐到萨尔瓦多的马里兰州父亲。

sentences.en: Yes, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: So when I first got this case on my radar, I don't really think it's going to be the thing it turned into,
sentences.zh: 所以当我第一次关注这个案子时，我真的没觉得它会演变成后来那样，

sentences.en: because this is a single individual who everyone agrees was wrongly removed to El Salvador when he had an order saying you cannot remove him to El Salvador
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个单一的个人，大家都同意他被错误地移交到了萨尔瓦多，而当时有一项命令说你不能把他移交给萨尔瓦多，

sentences.en: because he faces persecution or torture there.
sentences.zh: 因为他在那里面临迫害或酷刑。

sentences.en: And the government's a big entity.
sentences.zh: 政府是一个庞大的实体。

sentences.en: It makes mistakes.
sentences.zh: 它会犯错。

sentences.en: People get removed by mistake and have, throughout my time at DOJ, regardless of who the administration is, and we always bring them back.
sentences.zh: 人们会被错误地移交，在我司法部工作的这段时间里，无论哪个政府执政，这种情况都发生过，我们总是会把他们带回来。

sentences.en: So I immediately reach out to the clients.
sentences.zh: 所以我立即联系了客户。

sentences.en: In this case, that's Homeland Security and State.
sentences.zh: 在这个案子里，就是国土安全部和国务院。

sentences.en: And tee up the possibility of bringing him back and just making this case go away.
sentences.zh: 并提出了把他带回来并让这个案子了结的可能性。

sentences.en: But then come March 31st, we have a brief due in that case to articulate our position to the judge.
sentences.zh: 但到了3月31日，我们要在该案中提交一份简报，向法官阐明我们的立场。

sentences.en: And kind of out of nowhere, James Percival, who is a senior counselor to the secretary, Homeland Security, Secretary Noem, sends an email to the group.
sentences.zh: 然后，国土安全部部长诺姆（Noem）的高级顾问詹姆斯·珀西瓦尔（James Percival）突然给小组发了一封邮件。

sentences.en: And this is DOJ attorneys, Department of State attorneys, Department of Homeland Security attorneys, asking if we can essentially call Mr. Abrego Garcia some sort of MS-13 leader.
sentences.zh: 这是司法部律师、国务院律师、国土安全部律师，询问我们是否基本上可以称呼Abrego Garcia先生为某种MS-13头目。

sentences.en: A gang leader.
sentences.zh: 一个帮派头目。

sentences.en: Yeah, that Obrego Garcia is some sort of Kaiser Soce, some secret MS-13 mastermind.
sentences.zh: 是的，说Obrego Garcia是某种凯泽·索泽（Kaiser Soze），某种秘密的MS-13策划者。

sentences.en: And none of us had seen any evidence of that to date, even though we'd asked for it, because
sentences.zh: 而我们至今都没有看到任何证据，尽管我们已经索要过了，因为

sentences.en: the position that the administration is advancing in the press, what the press secretary and others are saying publicly is this guy's MS-13 mastermind, a very dangerous individual,
sentences.zh: 政府在媒体上推进的立场，即新闻秘书和其他人在公开场合所说的，是这家伙是MS-13的策划者，一个非常危险的个人，

sentences.en: a terroriSt.
sentences.zh: 一个恐怖分子。

sentences.en: And so that's all happening in public.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切都在公开场合发生着。

sentences.en: The crux of the email, if I'm calling it correctly, is that by calling this individual a leader of a transnational gang, if he's a very bad actor,
sentences.zh: 如果我没记错的话，这封邮件的核心是，通过称呼此人为跨国帮派的头目，如果他是一个非常坏的行事者，

sentences.en: well, who cares that we removed him incorrectly?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们错误地移交了他又有什么关系呢？

sentences.en: But then ICE was unable to corroborate the things Percival wanted to say to the court in a declaration, because there's no evidence for it whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 但后来ICE无法在声明中证实珀西瓦尔想对法庭说的话，因为根本没有任何证据支持这一点。

sentences.en: So what happens next?
sentences.zh: 那么接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: So we file the brief, and then on April 1st, I get this very ominous call in which it is conveyed to me that Mr. Bovey is very unhappy with a number of things,
sentences.zh: 所以我们提交了简报，然后在4月1日，我接到了一个非常不祥的电话，电话中传达给我的是，博维先生对很多事情非常不满，

sentences.en: including this brief that had stated that Mr. Abrego Garcia was removed by mistake.
sentences.zh: 包括这份陈述了Abrego Garcia先生是被错误移交的简报。

sentences.en: He didn't like that you had admitted to that.
sentences.zh: 他不高兴你承认了这一点。

sentences.en: He didn't like that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他不高兴美国

sentences.en: government had admitted to that.
sentences.zh: 政府承认了这一点。

sentences.zh: 那份简报是经过司法部和国土安全部许多律师审查过的。
